what_it_shows: Home audio lists about 20 children in this order: Receivers & Amplifiers, Home Speakers, Computer Audio, TV Sound Solutions, Audio Components, Turntables & Accessories, DACs, Preamps & Power Amps, High-resolution Audio, Home Stereo, Multi-room Audio, Smart Home, Table Radios & Stereo Systems, Power Protection, Headphones, Cables, Accessories, Karaoke; TVs and headphones also exist as separate departments

TV & Audio has 16 children: Fernseher, Beamer, Audiokomponenten, DVD & Blu-ray players, Radios, Kopfhoerer, Audio-Systeme, Lautsprecher, Car Hi-Fi, Audio/Video accessories, Portable audio, TV reception devices, Beamer accessories, TV accessories, DJ equipment & instruments, Vinyl; accessories are split per host device

Recommended Components: category pages (digital processors, preamplifiers, power amplifiers, integrated amplifiers, loudspeakers, subwoofers and others) each ranked Class A, B, C, D (A+ added for hi-res digital, turntables, phono preamps and headphones); class is by performance incl. test bench, price not explicit, lists reviewed products only

IEM ranking table: overall rank S- to F, value stars, price (MSRP), signature, separate Tone Grade and Technical Grade, driver setup string (for example 2EST 4BA 1DD), demo status; a named individual's list with a notes-and-disclaimers header

TV family tree: two roots LED(LCD) and OLED; LED has VA and IPS(ADS) types, OLED has WOLED and QD-OLED; Mini LED, QLED, Micro LED and RGB Mini LED listed as other types, with Mini LED and QLED called marketing terms; maker brand names (QNED, ULED, Triluminos) mapped to wide-gamut tech

Digital audio player (DAP) is a category of its own filed under PC: facets for audio functions (hi-res, balanced output, noise cancelling, dual DAC, USB DAC, dual amp), Bluetooth codecs (LDAC, aptX variants), device functions (FM tuner, voice recorder, lyrics), maker and series (WALKMAN A, WM1, ZX series)
Audio top page (only maker chips: Sony, Panasonic, Toshiba, JVC, Yamaha, Sennheiser; related categories audio software, batteries, power strips, instruments); category tree itself not rendered

ASR electronics list: device-type vocabulary (ADC/Soundcard, CD Player, DAC (Dedicated), Headphone Amp (Dongle), Headphone AMP, DAC+Headphone AMP, Power AMP, Amplifier, AVR/AVP (Pre Pro)); one measured number (SINAD in dB) plus Recommended yes/no per row

HS 8518 groups loudspeakers (single or multiple in enclosure), headphones and earphones, audio amplifiers and sound amplifier sets; 8519 record players (with or without loudspeaker); 8521 video recorders/players; 8522 pickup cartridges as parts; 8527 radio receivers; 8528 monitors, projectors and TV receivers

Headphone form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, earbud, in-ear), open/semi-open/closed back, wired versus wireless and true wireless, noise isolation and cancellation, transducer types (moving-coil, electrostatic, electret, planar magnetic, balanced armature, others)

r/headphones classification in order: backing (open, closed), form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, universal IEM, custom IEM), transducer technology (planar magnetic and others); example models per class

Hi-fi tree: Hi-Fi Separates (system deals, amplifiers & receivers, CD players, DACs, wireless streaming separates, tuners, turntables, mini hi-fi), Hi-Fi Speakers (bookshelf, floorstanding, active/powered, in-wall/ceiling, outdoor, subwoofers), Hi-fi accessories; wireless streaming separates are listed beside amplifiers

Soundbar Type facet mixes channel layout (2.1, 3.1, 5.1), connection (Bluetooth, wireless, wired), mounting (wall mounted), format (Dolby Atmos), size (compact) and bundle (with subwoofer, AV separates, home cinema systems) in one list, so entries overlap; separate facets for premium audio tech and voice control

Sound appliances (음향가전) split into HIFI/AV speakers, DAC/amp, soundbar, PA sound, microphone, all-in-one speaker, audio/player, AV receiver, earphones/headphones, accessories; page sits under home appliances/TV, not under computers or phones

Chinese headphone taxonomy: wearing style first (in-ear, semi-in-ear, flat-head earbud, ear-hook, over-ear/on-ear, bone conduction), then driver principle (dynamic, balanced armature, hybrid dynamic plus armature, electrostatic, planar, electret), then enclosure (closed, open, semi-open); notes reuse of generic mould designs across brands

Turntable guide: price tiers first (entry under 400 USD, mid 400-800, top 800 and up), then drive (belt, direct), operation (manual, semi-automatic, fully automatic), cartridge (MM/MC), phono preamp (built-in, in receiver, in powered speaker, separate), USB output

Speaker guide: system role first (2-channel stereo versus home theater 5.1/7.1/Atmos), then passive types (bookshelf, floor-standing, center, surround, height, in-ceiling and in-wall, outdoor) versus powered types (powered stereo, sound bars, powered subwoofers); driver layout two-way or three-way

Projector guide: decide by use first (movies, on the go, office, gaming), then resolution (HD Ready, WXGA, Full HD, 4K), screen size, connectivity; retailer sub-categories home cinema and gaming, 4K, HD, short throw, portable, accessories

Hi-fi modularity: separates (preamplifier, power amplifier, integrated amplifier, receiver, tuner, turntable, CD player, cartridges, tonearms) versus integrated mini/midi/music-centre systems; audiophiles prefer separates; monoblock; see-also lists AV receiver, boombox, cassette deck, radiogram, shelf stereo, table radio
Museum object-type vocabulary: radiograms, radios, record players, gramophones, radiogramophones under category Sound Reproduction; maker, place and date as facets (Braun Atelier 11, Decca Decola)

Smart speaker defined as a loudspeaker plus integrated virtual assistant; smart display (touchscreen) as subtype from 2017; may act as smart-home hub (Thread, Matter); grouped by assistant platform (Alexa, Google Assistant, Siri, Bixby, Clova, Alice)

TV product rows carry: screen size, type (for example 4K LCD TV), backlight (LED or mini LED), quantum dot, motion rate, HDMI count, tuners; backlight-type facet edge-lit (14) versus direct (432); tuner facets (BS 8K, BS/CS 4K, terrestrial); maker then series (Hisense U8R, TVS REGZA, BRAVIA)

Integrated amplifier (プリメインアンプ) is its own category under home electronics: spec lines rated output, impedance, built-in DAC, digital inputs, phono input, pre-out, headphone out; user review and ranking sub-pages

Chinese speaker listing puts smart speakers (Xiaomi, HomePod mini), Bluetooth/party speakers (JBL PartyBox), soundbars/center (JBL Cinema SB550), karaoke-style and desktop speakers into one 音箱 list; product URL paths use sub-sections speaker, portablespeaker, loudspeaker

HiFi.de topics: HiFi Elektronik (Vollverstaerker, Endstufe, Plattenspieler, Streaming-Verstaerker), AV-Receiver, Gaming; editorial note that integrated devices (amp and speakers in one housing) are the trend while separates remain the next level

German specialist retailer top categories: Stereo-Verstaerker, Lautsprecher, Plattenspieler, AV-Receiver, HiFi-Anlagen, HiFi-Kopfhoerer; guides on AV receiver versus soundbar, streaming, headphone type

TV screen types as buying choices: LED (edge-lit and full array), QLED, Neo QLED (Mini-LED plus quantum dot), Mini-LED, OLED, QD-OLED, MicroLED; each given an experience-level tier word (Basis, Gut, Sehr gut, Spitzenklasse, Absolute Spitzenklasse)

Headphones department has 13 children mixing axes: noise-canceling, in-ear & earbud, audiophile, wireless Bluetooth, wireless TV, true wireless, wired, sports, on-ear, over-the-ear, studio, gaming headsets; the shopping guide opens with form factor (over-ear, on-ear, in-ear) then connection then feature

Stereophile headphone section rates headphones, headphone amplifiers, DAC/amps and IEMs together with Class A+ at top; named models (Focal Utopia, HiFiMan Susvara, Stax SR-007S with SRM-700S energiser, Sennheiser HD 650, Focal Bathys, B&W Px8, Campfire Andromeda 10) carry open/closed, planar, electrostatic and wireless notes

Speakers & Hi-Fi systems children: portable Bluetooth, wireless, Megasound party, multi-room, Hi-fi systems (traditional hi-fis); speaker categories here follow use and connection rather than cabinet form

Earphones/headphones children: true wireless, Bluetooth headphones, inner-ear, over-head, monitor headphones, wireless headphones, gaming headset, neckband, monaural earphones, surround headphones, headphone accessories; mixes form, wireless and use

Projector picks carry attributes Projector Type (Standard Throw, Short Throw, Ultra Short Throw), Native Resolution (1080p, pixel-shift 4K), Light Source (laser, LED); picks grouped by price and use (top, upper mid-range, mid-range, budget, ultra-short-throw, portable); usage scores home theater, outdoors, bedroom, gaming

NAICS 334310 Audio and Video Equipment Manufacturing; marketing-level 334310-11 stereophonic and high-fidelity equipment lists turntables, CD players, amplifiers, speakers, headphones, microphones, mixers, audio interfaces and studio monitors together (consumer and pro not separated)

Loudspeaker list is sub-grouped inside each class by bass reach: A (Full Range), A (Restricted Extreme LF), B (Full Range), B (Restricted LF), C (Restricted LF); named models include B&W 801 D4 Signature, Wilson Audio Sasha V, KEF Blade Two Meta, Monitor Audio Platinum 300 3G; a spec attribute is recorded beside the tier

TV page: first shopping step is size and screen technology (OLED or LED), main types LED (backlit, brighter) and OLED (self-lit); related searches by size band, brand and feature (full-array local dimming)
